name: solix
description: Drive a Solix host — persistent terminals, a coding-agent crew with a First Mate orchestrator, projects, shared memory, and Helm registers — through the Solix MCP and CLI skill set.

interface.longDescription: Control a Solix host from chat: list and read persistent terminals, send verified briefs to the First Mate orchestrator, spawn worker agents on installed coding CLIs, submit work to the routed task queue, consult consumer chat advisers, check provider usage limits, list projects, and inspect uncommitted git diffs. Requires a Solix account and a host on your machine running `solix mcp cloud on`. Elevated tools — secrets, kill, value writes, machine control — run only while the operator holds the matching grant open at mcp.solix.fyi/grants, and secret values are never returned.
capabilities: Send work to the First Mate orchestrator
Submit, approve, and track routed tasks
defaultPrompt: List my Solix terminals and their states.
Tell my First Mate what to work on next.
Submit a task to fix the login redirect bug.
How much is left in my usage windows?
